newsitem.title: USA: KANSAS FED CATTLE TRADE RATHER SLOW AT $65 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: KANSAS FED CATTLE TRADE RATHER SLOW AT $65 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow, with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry was moderate, demand rather light.

Sales confirmed on 3,400 slaughter steers and 2,000 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 57,100 head confirmed including 37,900 head or about 66 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 65.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 65.00.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
